notes: Demo (mock) mode now shows the full feature set: an anonymized, real-shaped dataset (data/demo_dataset.json, built by tools/build_demo_dataset.py from a live harvest with every identifier stripped) fills firmware coverage, shelves/drives, ports, licences, ASUP history, SVM/LIF detail, adoption mixes, lifecycle events, cases and the account-level TAM datasets for the 13 demo customers. Tracker, history and ASUP-import endpoints are served from memory in demo mode so the real database is never read or written.
